headline: Türkiye Repays $2.6 Billion to 420,000 Liquidated Fund Investors
summary: Treasury and Finance Minister Mehmet Simsek announced that Türkiye has distributed $2.6 billion to over 420,000 investors, with nearly 180,000 individuals recovering full net investments amid ongoing fund liquidations.
why: Turkish capital market regulatory payouts are critical for maintaining domestic retail investor confidence during macroeconomic stabilization.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Payout repayments resolve lingering financial liabilities and support capital market integrity.
